prereveal_tests.mechanism: local Python unittest execution against local files whose Git blob IDs and SHA-256 values were verified equal to the frozen repository blobs

interpretation_uncertainties: Timestamp grammar permits four decimal year digits but does not explicitly state a year-zero convention; the implementation rejects year 0000 and uses Gregorian calendar validity for years 0001-9999.
The phrase 'new explicit subject_id' was interpreted fail-closed as requiring each delegation subject_id to differ from its immediate parent's subject_id.

The phrase 'Delegation may change the authorized subject only' was read as constraining authority/jurisdiction dimensions, not per-record validity timestamps, because the explicit preserved-field list omits valid_from, valid_until, and revoked_at; each record's time bounds are therefore independently evaluated.

For already-decoded Python values, independent JCS rejects integer objects outside the interoperable safe-integer interval -(2^53-1) through +(2^53-1); finite IEEE-754 float values use ECMAScript-compatible shortest serialization.

AuthorizationState recomputation was interpreted to require the supplied state object itself to be canonicalizable JSON before authority_state_id is excluded; a non-canonicalizable host-only value in that field therefore yields null recomputed_authority_state_id.
apparatus_deviations: rfc8785==0.1.4 was not installed in the runtime; an attempted exact-version pip install failed because the execution environment had no network/DNS access, so a self-contained independent JCS implementation was used.
Prereveal execution used local staging under /mnt/data/contract_e_work only; no repository checkout or repository-tree inspection was used.

Node.js v22.16.0 was used only as a generic standards sanity check for independent finite-float JSON rendering during development; it is not imported or required by the frozen implementation or prereveal test suite.
GitHub contents writes were necessarily file-scoped commits; the recorded freeze commit is the exact commit where the final implementation blob and frozen prereveal-test blob coexist.
